news.story: Reed was a difference-maker off the bench, setting a season high in assists. news.headline: New Orleans Pelicans vs. Oklahoma City Thunder: Game Highlights

news.headline: Peterson produced 20 points (7-20 FG, 0-7 3Pt, 6-8 FT), 10 rebounds, eight assists, two steals and one block over 32 minutes in Friday's 111-101 loss to the Suns.
news.story: This was an excellent bounce-back performance from Peterson, who was limited to just 11 points over 19 foul-plagued minutes in Wednesday's win over the Lakers. He recorded the first double-double of his career, and to put a bow on the sterling outing, the rookie finished the game with just one turnover.

news.headline: Peterson ended Wednesday's 109-97 win over the Lakers with 11 points (3-5 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 4-6 FT), one rebound and three assists over 19 minutes.
news.story: Peterson made an efficient contribution in limited playing time, although his 19-minute workload was considerably smaller than those of Keyonte George and Ace Bailey. The rookie continues to compete for opportunities in Utah's crowded backcourt, and his ability to generate offense remains encouraging. While this game was a step in the wrong direction, Peterson had played at least 30 minutes in each of his previous…

news.headline: Peterson logged 13 points (3-10 FG, 2-4 3Pt, 5-7 FT), five rebounds, two assists and one steal in 31 minutes during Tuesday's 132-107 victory over the Clippers.
news.story: Peterson never found his shooting touch, but he still finished with a decent total as the Jazz snapped their long losing streak. The No. 2 overall pick has been one of the few bright spots in a rough start for the club, averaging 17.1 points as a rookie. With Lauri Markkanen (hand) and Jaren Jackson (knee) sidelined, Peterson should continue to get a heavy share of the offense.

news.headline: LA Clippers vs. Dallas Mavericks: Game Highlights
Irving supplied 17 points (7-15 FG, 1-6 3Pt, 2-2 FT), six rebounds, five assists and two steals over 29 minutes during Wednesday's 116-94 win over Golden State.
news.story: After sitting out the second game of a weekend back-to-back set, Irving returned to action and delivered decent numbers. The veteran point guard has scored in double digits in all 12 of his games this season, and he's contributed at least five boards and five assists in three of his seven November contests, averaging 22.9 points, 4.1 assists, 3.9 rebounds, 3.4 threes and 1.4 steals.

news.headline: Irving (knee) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
news.story: Irving didn't play in Sunday's 131-94 loss to Boston, the second game of a back-to-back for the Mavericks. He will return Wednesday for the meeting with Golden State, likely resulting in Naji Marshall heading back to the bench.

news.headline: Black finished with 13 points (4-11 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 3-8 FT), seven rebounds, six assists, two blocks and three steals across 37 minutes during Friday's 113-111 win over the Nets.
news.story: Black has been struggling from an efficiency standpoint over the past few games, going 10-for-27 from the field and 4-for-11 from the free-throw line, but the counting stats have been great. This was Black's second game of the season recording at least six assists, three steals and two blocks, and with 1.9 steals per game on the year, he ranks in the top 10 among qualified players.

news.headline: Black totaled 15 points (6-16 FG, 2-5 3Pt, 1-3 FT), two rebounds, six assists, one block and one steal in 37 minutes during Wednesday's 121-116 loss to the 76ers.
news.story: Black continues to benefit from Paolo Banchero's (ankle) absence, maintaining a substantial offensive role despite inconsistent shooting. Black's playmaking and defensive contributions provide a reliable fantasy foundation, while increased shot volume offers scoring upside. He's worth holding across formats, although Banchero's eventual return could reduce his opportunities.

His minutes remain encouraging, but limited rebounding and defensive contributions make him a risky fantasy option.
